description: This file defines a class 'TestEnvironmentCommands' that provides command-line interface functionalities for configuring testing environments, installing and running ChromeDriver, and setting environment variables for different operating systems within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for environment setup, ChromeDriver management, and OS-specific environment configuration.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentCommands
classes.description: A class extending 'obo	asks' that provides CLI commands for setting up testing environments, managing ChromeDriver, and configuring environment variables across operating systems within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: configureTests
methods.description: Configures the testing environment by setting database and SuiteCRM instance parameters, and installs OS-specific environment variables.

methods.name: chromeDriverInstall
methods.description: Downloads and installs the ChromeDriver executable, with an option to force reinstallation.

methods.name: chromeDriverRun
methods.description: Runs the ChromeDriver server with specified URL base, assuming it is installed.

methods.name: fakeTravis
methods.description: Sets up environment variables to imitate a Travis CI environment, tailored for different OS types.
